name: The CFB Slate
blurb: Invite-only college football ratings, pick'em, and bet tracking for my friend group.
highlights: Elo-style ratings with separate offense and defense, tempo and team-specific home field
Picks stay hidden until kickoff and the bet ledger is append-only, enforced in the database
A Receipts page grades every flagged edge against the closing line

name: Fairway Picks
highlights: Live leaderboard from ESPN with a projected cut line and head-to-head margins
Snake draft that updates in real time across devices
Money tracked automatically from finalized results

name: Courtside Edge
highlights: Efficiency and tempo model, with home court fitted per team from four seasons of games
Lines are snapshotted through the day to measure closing line value
Picks, grading and results all run on scheduled jobs, with no database

name: Jarvis
blurb: Home AI system running on a Linux box. Voice notes, smart home control, family dashboard.
highlights: Plain-English room commands, run through Home Assistant
Web Push implemented by hand, with no push library
Overnight research jobs run by headless Claude

name: Chase City
blurb: Pixel-art town where each running Claude Code agent is a worker in a building.
highlights: Claude Code hooks report each event; the session's folder decides which building
Reads send a worker to the library, edits show construction, tests bring an inspector
Day and night follow the real sun, with live weather

name: TV Overlay
blurb: Android app that draws live scores and my bets over whatever is on the Fire TV.
highlights: A foreground service draws a web view over whatever is on screen
Controlled from a phone, through a page the TV app serves itself
Sideloaded, starts on boot and updates itself from CI builds

name: FlooRory
blurb: Projector floor game I built for my daughter.
highlights: Webcam motion tracking that ignores the projector's own picture
Calibrates itself by projecting a grid of dots and solving the camera-to-floor mapping
Phone remote, a 15-minute timer and a gentle wind-down

name: ORION
blurb: AI marketing operating system for small businesses.
highlights: 14 specialised agents covering strategy, copy, SEO, ads, lead scoring and more
Six-stage pipeline with human approval before anything publishes
Pre-flight checks for brand safety, character limits and spam signals

name: Christie's Golf Ranch
blurb: Marketing site, admin CMS and social posting engine for a driving range.

name: Chase OS
blurb: Personal command center on top of Notion, built for the iPad.

name: golf-oracle
blurb: PGA Tour predictor that simulates each tournament 50,000 times for win, top-10 and cut odds.

name: fantasybaseballkeepers
blurb: Keeper picker for my fantasy baseball league, with the league's service-time and franchise-tag rules built in.

name: fantraxapi
blurb: Fantasy baseball war room that pulls league data from Fantrax and asks Claude for draft advice.

name: kitchen-homebase
blurb: Kitchen wall display with weather, calendar, photos and what's playing.

name: kidbook-creator
blurb: Picture-book editor that exports print-ready PDFs for Amazon KDP.

name: wilderwhim-woods
blurb: Site for the children's book Barry Is Terrific, with printable activities and a seek-and-find game.

name: Website redesign business
blurb: Config-driven website templates for local small businesses. Early stage.
